Downloading libLCS

The file releases of libLCS can be downloaded from the links provided at the libLCS project page here. See the Installing and Building Applications Using libLCS page for instructions on installing/building the library. See the Examples of Using libLCS and libLCS Tutorial and User Guide pages for information on using the library.

Due to lack of un-restricted internet access currently, I am unable to provide timely CVS updates for the project. For sometime to come, file releases will be the only downloadable bundles of libLCS.
